message: No water in the lane for nine days
detail: The municipal tap in our lane has been dry since the pipe burst near the chowk. About forty households are buying jars. The ward office said a team would come on Sunday. Nobody came, and the broken section is still open.
requested_action: Repair the pipe and restore the morning supply. Tell the ward which day the water will return.

message: The school road is broken and floods
detail: The blacktop in front of the school has a hole about a meter wide. Children walk around it into the drain when it rains. Two tempos have already scraped the edge.
requested_action: Fill the hole before the school week and put a temporary barrier until the patch is finished.
